title: EXAMINING THE ALIGNMENT OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS THROUGH REPRESENTATIVE HEURISTICS: THE CASE OF POLITICAL STEREOTYPES

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-generated predictions of political party stances (Democrats and Republicans) against empirical human survey responses from the American National Election Studies (ANES) and the Moral Foundation Questionnaire (MFQ) to quantify stereotypical exaggeration using representativeness heuristics.
